answer: A newcomer claims one cell on a public atlas and tends an orchard of three live jobs, each checked at a vertex checkpoint by a different stranger who re-runs the job and stakes 2 POA it was real. The newcomer posts a 7 POA bond per vertex; a failed check slashes the bond and strikes the cell from the atlas. The nth identity from one wallet tends n orchards and posts 7n² POA — 1st 7, 10th 700, 2,695 across ten — so clones cannot share one orchard's honest work.
